The '''Temple of Kooroo''' was a [[Shrine of Kooroo]] located on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vaynai/Legends|Vaynai]]. One of a series of similar ancient stone structures that were believed to have been constructed by an advanced [[Kooroo (species)|alien species]] on several worlds throughout known [[Realspace/Legends|space]], the temple on Vaynai was a domed building located on the top surface of [[Streysel Island]].

Early [[Scout/Legends|explorers]] discovered the [[Kooroo Sundial]] artifact in the Temple of Kooroo, and eventually both the artifact and the entire Streysel Island, including the temple, came into the possession of the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] and art [[Collector/Legends|collector]] [[Gallo Memm]]. Although the Temple of Kooroo was situated on the grounds of [[Memm's estate]], the collector allowed groups of [[Pilgrimage of Kooroo|pilgrims]] of the [[Fellowship of Kooroo]], a cult dedicated to the worship of the Kooroo shrines, to visit the sanctuary on his property under armed escort and spend the [[Standard day/Legends|night]] [[Meditation/Legends|meditating]] inside the shrine.

==Description==
The Temple of Kooroo was a [[Shrine of Kooroo]] located on the<ref name="Topside" /> [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Vaynai system/Legends|Vaynai system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Archipelago">{{GamerCite|8|The Vaynai Archipelago}}</ref> [[Vaynai/Legends|Vaynai]]. The temple was situated in one corner of the top surface of<ref name="Topside" /> the mesa-like [[Streysel Island]] in the [[Vaynai Archipelago]].<ref name="Archipelago" /> Located at one end of a crushed-stone path that led to the interior of the island's surface, the temple was surrounded by dense [[Plant/Legends|underbrush]].<ref name="Topside" />

[[File:MemmEstate-Gamer8.png|thumb|left|250px|The Temple of Kooroo was located in one corner of Gallo Memm's estate, which encompassed the entire top surface of Streysel Island.]]
Like most of the other Shrines of Kooroo located on several worlds<ref name="Journal14">{{JournalCite|14|From the Files of Corellia Antilles}}</ref> throughout known [[Realspace/Legends|space]],<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> the ancient ruin on Vaynai<ref name="Topside" /> was built from a certain type of native stone.<ref name="Journal14 Shrines" /> Unlike the other Shrines of Kooroo, however, the Vaynai temple was not a three-level building with an upper level that consisted of a roof raised over a round solid stone structure.<ref name="Journal14" /> Instead, it was a massive round dome topped by a one-[[Meter/Legends|meter]] wide opening that was in turn covered by a small dome-shaped cupola supported by four short pillars. The entire structure was approximately forty-eight meters in diameter.<ref name="Topside" />

A small pillared portico and nearly twenty-meter-long stairs made of worn stone steps led into the central domed sanctuary chamber, which was at least twenty-four meters across. The chamber was bare of any furnishing except for a low stone platform running along the perimeter of the room. The upper opening in the sanctuary's dome, which was located seven meters above the chamber floor, permitted light and [[Atmosphere/Legends|air]] to flow into the room, although the vents beneath the cupola were only 0.3 meters wide and the light that filtered through was dim and left the sanctuary's edge in shadow. The domed sanctuary was surrounded by a wide ledge. One narrow stone in the wall facing away from the shrine's entrance was loose, and vines were creeping along the structure's cracked, two-meter-thick outer walls.<ref name="Topside" />

==History==
===Evidence of the ancient past===
{{Quote|One theory is that the shrines served the Kooroo civilization as a kind of communication network, boosting their telepathic powers enough to overcome vast interstellar distances. This is an intriguing theory, but evidence is lacking.|Lecture by [[Doctor/Legends|Dr.]] [[Henrietya Antilles|Corellia Antilles]]|<ref name="Journal14" />}}
[[File:Gallo_Memm.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The Temple of Kooroo was situated on the property of Gallo Memm.]]
Although general consensus among [[Scholar/Legends|scholars]]<ref name="Journal14" /> by [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]]<ref name="11 ABY">{{JournalCite|14|From the Files of Corellia Antilles}} is set "shortly after the re-establishment of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]" following the [[Battle of Onderon (Galactic Civil War)|final death]] of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]].</ref> was that the Shrines of Kooroo were built by an advanced [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Species/Legends|species]] known as the [[Kooroo (species)|Kooroo]], the purpose of the structures was still unclear by that [[Time/Legends|time]], with various theories claiming that the shrines were used by the aliens for interstellar [[Telepathy/Legends|telepathic]] communication or even teleportation.<ref name="Journal14" />

Early [[Scout/Legends|explorers]] on Vaynai discovered the [[Kooroo Sundial]] in the Temple of Kooroo. The disk-shaped metal artifact featured intricate engravings of symbols, geometric designs, and notations and misleadingly resembled an ancient sundial overall. Eventually, both the Kooroo Sundial<ref name="Topside" /> and the entire Streysel Island passed into the ownership of the eccentric<ref name="Archipelago" /> [[Nimbanel/Legends|Nimbanel]]<ref name="Topside" /> [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]]<ref name="CSWE Memm">{{CSWECite|II|305|Memm, Gallo}}</ref> and art [[Collector/Legends|collector]] [[Gallo Memm]]. Memm maintained an [[Memm's estate|estate]] that encompassed the entire top surface of the island, including the Temple of Kooroo.<ref name="Topside" />

===A pilgrimage site===
Memm allowed<ref name="Topside" /> members of the [[Fellowship of Kooroo]], a cult worshipping the Shrines of Kooroo,<ref name="Platt">''[[Platt's Starport Guide]]''</ref> to visit the Temple of Kooroo<ref name="Topside" /> as part of a [[Pilgrimage of Kooroo|pilgrimage]] to various sites connected to the organization's supposed spiritual leader, [[Kooroo (being)|Kooroo]].<ref name="Platt" /> Visiting pilgrims arrived on Memm's estate grounds via a [[Turbolift/Legends|lifttube]] that connected the island's top surface to the [[Cave/Legends|caverns]] excavated below and, ultimately, to the public landing platforms.<ref name="Topside" />

A [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of six armed [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Security guard/Legends|guards]] then escorted the pilgrims along the gravel path connecting the lifttube pavilion at the estate's center to the temple. At [[Star/Legends|sunset]], the guards ushered the pilgrims into the temple's interior. There, the pilgrims arranged themselves in a large circle along the stone platform at the edge of the chamber, assumed positions for [[Meditation/Legends|meditation]] and continued their previously-initiated chanting. During the [[Standard day/Legends|night]] of meditations that followed, the pilgrims inside the shrine rarely communicated with the guards standing outside, four of whom were stationed at the entrance of the temple with the other two wandering the paths near the structure. In the morning, the Weequays escorted the pilgrims back to the lifttube pavilion.<ref name="Topside" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Temple of Kooroo appeared in the [[roleplaying game]] adventure "[[Topside Infiltration]]," which was authored by [[Peter M. Schweighofer|Peter Schweighofer]] for use with the [[Wizards of the Coast]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'', illustrated by [[Carl Critchlow]], and published in [[Star Wars Gamer 8|''Star Wars Gamer'' 8]]<ref name="Topside" /> on [[December 21]], [[2001]].<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=gaming/other/rpg/news20011210.html|text=Yuuzhan Vong Invade ''Gamer'' #8}}</ref> In the adventure, the player characters are seeking to [[Heist at Memm's villa|steal valuables]] from [[Memm's villa|Gallo Memm's villa]]. The characters are provided with several ways to get inside the closely-guarded estate, and the most indirect approach involves posing as pilgrims visiting the Temple of Kooroo.<ref name="Topside" />

[[File:Topside_Infiltration_G8.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The Temple of Kooroo serves as a possible setting in the roleplaying adventure "Topside Infiltration."]]
If the characters choose this approach, they are led into the temple along with the other pilgrims and must then devise a way to exit the shrine unnoticed. The scenario suggests four possible means of escaping the structure. The characters can either attempt to exit through the cupola-covered opening in the domed sanctuary's ceiling, or they can remove the loose stone&mdash;which the adventure's text erroneously describes as being a part of the structure's dome, as opposed to being situated outside the dome per the map of the temple&mdash;in the structure's wall and escape through the resulting passage. Alternatively, the characters can lure the Weequay guards standing outside into the temple by simulating an emergency situation and then disable them. Finally, the player characters can simply assault the sentries outside and attempt to quickly and discreetly disable them in order to be able to freely navigate through Memm's estate.<ref name="Topside" />
